summary.headline: The Seven Planetary Millennia
summary.text: Discussion of the Chaldaean origin of the doctrine of seven planetary ages or millennia, citing Mandaean parallels and Georgius Scholarios (Gennadius). Gennadius’s account describes Saturn’s first millennium, the Moon’s seventh, planetary conjunctions in Leo and Cancer, and alternate traditions of conflagration and deluge involving Berosus and Seneca.
